quotes.title: LHS 1678
quotes.card: LHS 1678 (TOI-696) is an astrometric binary star system, located about 65 light-years from the Earth in the constellation Caelum.
quotes.introduction: It is made up of a red dwarf and a companion star whose nature is still uncertain, but is likely to be a brown dwarf.
